cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
ls c_suite/ | head; ls c_suite/bin 2>/dev/null | head -3
cat > .gitignore <<'EOF'
# regenerable experiment outputs (hundreds of MB; rebuild via c_suite Makefile + scripts)
c_suite/out/
c_suite/out_large/
c_suite/bin/
*.o

*.aux
*.log
*.toc

EOF
du -sh --exclude=out --exclude=out_large --exclude=bin c_suite 2>/dev/null || du -sh c_suite/src c_suite/include c_suite/analysis 2>/dev/null
